stemMarkdown: By selling an article for Rs. 2250.00, a shopkeeper incurs a loss of 25%. At what price (in Rs.) should he sell it to make a profit of 10%?
solutionMarkdown: A 25% loss means SP is $75\%$ of CP, so CP $= 2250.00 \times \dfrac{100}{75} = 3000$. For a 10% profit, SP $= 3000 \times \dfrac{110}{100} = 3300.0$.
